result.topic_en: Riemann evaluates the contour integral of $(z-a)^\alpha(z-b)^\beta(z-c)^\gamma(z-d)^\delta$ along the real axis closed by a large half-circle. This gives a linear relation among the integrals $(a,b),(b,c),(c,d),(d,a)$, which he then expresses through the functions $\mathfrak{P}$ to derive transformation (connection) relations between $P(\lambda,\mu,\nu,x)$ and $P(\nu,\mu,\lambda,1-x)$.
result.transcription:
[-$(a,b)\sin k$-]
[-$a \quad b \quad c \quad d$-]
$\int Z\,\partial z \cdot\; Z=(z-a)^\alpha(z-b)^\beta(z-c)^\gamma(z-d)^\delta$.
$\int Z\,\partial z$ [?] durch die Ergänzung eines [-unendlich-] grossen Halbkreises ausgedehnt. Dieser [?] von $-R$ bis $+R$ durch reelle Werthe und von $+R$ bis $-R$ [-durch Werthe in der-] [?] von dem Argument von $0$ zu $-\pi$ übergehen läßt. $(z-a)^\alpha$ [-unendlich[?] ... reell-] wenn $(z-a)$ positiv, also der $Z$ ausserhalb des Halbkreises stetig $=e^{-\alpha\pi i}(a-z)^\alpha$ wenn $z-a$ negativ.
$(Z)=$ [-Mod. $C$ von $Z$-]
$e^{-\pi(\alpha+\beta+\gamma+\delta)i}\int^a (Z)\,\partial z+e^{-\pi(\beta+\gamma+\delta)i}\int_a^b (Z)\,\partial z+e^{-\pi(\gamma+\delta)i}\int_b^c (Z)\,\partial z$
$+e^{-\pi\delta i}\int_c^{d} (Z)\,\partial z+\int_d^\infty (Z)\,\partial z$
$e^{-\pi(\alpha+\beta+\gamma+\delta)i}=1 \;|\;$ [-$(\infty,a)$-] $+e^{-\pi(\beta+\gamma+\delta)i}(a,b)+e^{-\pi}$ $\ldots +(d,a)=0$.
$(a,b)\sin(k+\alpha)\pi+(b,c)\sin(k+\alpha+\beta)\pi+(c,d)\sin(k+\alpha+\beta+\gamma)\pi+(d,a)\sin k\pi$
[-$(a,b)=\mathfrak{P}\,\lambda,\mu$-]

$x=\frac{(a-b)(c-d)}{(a-c)(b-d)}$ $\quad a<b<c<d. \quad 0<1$
$\int_a^b Z\,\partial z=x^{\frac{\alpha+\beta+1}{2}+\frac16}(1-x)^{\frac{\alpha+\delta+1}{2}+\frac16}\,\mathfrak{P}(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,x)$
$(a,b)=x^{\frac{\alpha+\beta+1}{2}+\frac16}(1-x)^{\frac{\alpha+\delta+1}{2}+\frac16}\,\mathfrak{P}(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,x)$
$(b,c)=(1-x)^{\frac{\beta+\gamma+1}{2}+\frac16}(x)^{\frac{\gamma+\beta+1}{2}+\frac16}\,\mathfrak{P}(\gamma,\beta,\alpha,1-x)$
$(c,d)=x^{\frac{\gamma+\delta+1}{2}+\frac16}(1-x)^{\frac{\gamma+\beta+1}{2}+\frac16}\,\mathfrak{P}(\gamma,\delta,\alpha,x)$
$(d,a)=x^{\frac{\delta+\alpha+1}{2}+\frac16}\left(\frac{x}{1-x}\right)^{\frac{\beta+\delta+1}{2}+\frac16}\,\mathfrak{P}(\alpha,\delta,\gamma,1-x)$
$\mathfrak{P}(\alpha+\beta+1,\alpha+\gamma+1,\alpha+\delta+1,x)$ ($\lambda\quad\mu\quad\nu$)
$=$ [-$(\alpha+\lambda$-] $,\mu,\nu,$
$=\mathfrak{P}(\gamma+\delta+1,\gamma+\alpha+1,\gamma+\beta+1,x)$

[-$(a,b)\sin k=0$-] $(b,c)\sin(\alpha+\beta)\pi=-\sin\alpha\pi\,(a,b)+\sin\delta\pi\,(c,d)$
$\mathfrak{P}(\gamma,\beta,\alpha,1-x)$ [-...-] $\sin(\alpha+\beta)\pi$ [-...-] $=-\mathfrak{P}(\beta,\alpha,\delta,x)\,x^{\frac{\alpha+\beta+1}{2}}\sin\alpha\pi+\mathfrak{P}(\gamma,\delta,\alpha,x)\sin\delta\pi$
$\mathfrak{P}(\alpha,\delta,\gamma,1-x)\;\sin(\gamma+\delta)\pi=-\mathfrak{P}(\delta,\gamma,\beta,x)\,x^{\delta+\gamma+1}\sin\gamma\pi+\mathfrak{P}(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,x)\sin\beta\pi$
$\mathfrak{P}(\nu,\mu,\lambda,1-x)\sin\lambda\pi=-\mathfrak{P}(\lambda,\mu,\nu,x)$ [-$\frac{\sin\ldots}{\cos\lambda-\mu-\nu}$-] $\cos\frac{\lambda-\mu-\nu}{2}\pi+\mathfrak{P}(-\lambda,-\mu,\nu,x)\cos\frac{-\lambda+\mu-\nu}{2}\pi$
[-Diese Relationen ersch[?]-]
$\mathfrak{P}(-\nu,-\mu,\lambda,1-x)\sin\lambda\pi=$ [-$\frac{\ldots}{\ldots}$-] $-\mathfrak{P}(\lambda,\mu,\nu,x)\cos\frac{\lambda+\mu+\nu}{2}\pi+\mathfrak{P}(-\lambda,-\mu,\nu,x)\cos\frac{-\lambda+\mu+\nu}{2}\pi$
